name: Hafgufa Will

abilities.name: Barnacle Hide
abilities.effect: A crust of barnacles hardens over the skin: reduced damage for about 7 seconds.

abilities.name: Lure Glow
abilities.effect: The brow glows with a pale lure and the holder senses the creatures it draws near, outlining up to six.

acquire.equipPiece: One barnacle-crusted shoulder guard on the left shoulder (the only equipped piece); a ripple under each heavy step.

abilities.name: Sweet Breath
abilities.effect: A sweet-smelling cloud rolls out: foes inside are lulled, slowed and drawn to stumble toward the holder.

abilities.name: Great Swallow
abilities.effect: The maw opens and a swallowing current drags foes in, then slams shut for heavy damage.

integrate.transformation: Whole body becomes a fish-whale beastman in barnacle-island armour: wide gaping maw with rows of teeth, glowing lure bulb on the brow, kelp-green hair, shell plates across back and shoulders, broad finned clawed arms with a jawbone maul, thick digitigrade legs and a heavy fluke tail.

equip.weapon: A whale-jawbone maul: a curved jaw of teeth grown from the maw, swung two-handed.
equip.armor: Barnacle-island shell plates over back and shoulders, finned bracers, a heavy tail-fluke skirt.
equip.hair_eyes: Long sea-green hair drifting like kelp; eyes pale with a lure-light glow.
equip.aura: Sweet pale mist with slow rising bubbles.

lore: The Hafgufa floats like an island and breathes a sweet scent that draws fish, then ships, into its maw. Its will is a patient, heavy tide.
pitch: The Hafgufa is an island-sized sea monster that lures prey with a sweet mist and swallows it whole. Acquire keeps you human with heavy ripple-steps and one barnacle shoulder guard, lending a hard hide and a lure-light that outlines nearby creatures. Integrate makes you a broad fish-whale beastman in barnacle-island armour with a gaping maw and a fluke tail, a near-unbreakable tank whose lulling breath and swallow current cost a slow, tiring strain.
untrained: An untrained holder tires and feels the lure: slow heavy limbs, a ringing sweetness in the nose and a hunger to walk into the dark water; strain climbs while standing still. Canon: a will that is not suppressed or balanced disrupts body and mana core and can eventually kill the holder, so the first Awakening (forced, a spark in the core) is the most dangerous moment and training both cores is the cure.

spirit.echo: A broad heavy fish-whale beastman: huge gaping maw, barnacled island-like back, finned clawed arms, thick tail fluke, a lure-glow on the brow.
spirit.look: A barnacle-crusted teal orb shaped like a small island; a pale lure-light glows in a slit on its top and exhales faint bubbles.
